title.zh: Philippines eyes payment operator registration freeze, tighter VASP checks
title.en: Philippines eyes payment operator registration freeze, tighter VASP checks

current_state.zh: The Philippines' central bank proposes a 12-month freeze on new payment operator registrations and tighter oversight of payment arrangements involving virtual asset service providers.
current_state.en: The Philippines' central bank proposes a 12-month freeze on new payment operator registrations and tighter oversight of payment arrangements involving virtual asset service providers.

updates.background_zh: 菲律宾的支付系统运营商是根据《国家支付系统法》需要在菲律宾央行登记的实体，央行借此对全国支付基础设施进行监督。虚拟资产服务提供商则通过BSP第944号通告及其后续修订受到监管。该草案针对的是商户收单服务——即为商户签约并处理交易的支付机构——当其商户属于受BSP、菲律宾SEC或其他相关机构监管的VASP时，需要满足更严要求。
updates.background_en: Operators of payment systems in the Philippines are entities that require registration with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas under the National Payment Systems Act, which gives the central bank oversight of the country's payment infrastructure. Virtual asset service providers are regulated by the BSP through Circular No. 944 and later amendments. The draft circular targets merchant acquisition services—payment firms that sign up and process transactions for merchants—when those merchants are VASPs supervised by the BSP, SEC, or another relevant authority.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该提案针对VASP与国内支付体系之间的法币出入金环节，因此面向菲律宾市场的交易平台和支付处理商可能面临支付渠道收窄和尽职调查负担上升。市场传导影响可能较为间接，主要经由监管不确定性和运营成本变化，而非通过供给或托管渠道。
updates.market_impact_en: The proposal targets the fiat on/off-ramp layer between VASPs and the domestic payment system, so Philippine-facing exchanges and payment processors could face narrower payment channels and higher due-diligence burdens. Market transmission is likely indirect, operating through perceived regulatory risk and operational costs rather than through supply or custody channels.
